name: Fireman Sam
description: Follow the adventures of fireman Sam and his colleagues as they protect the citizens of the Welsh town of Pontypandy. Whenever the alarm sounds, brave Sam and his co-workers can be counted on to jump into a fire engine, hop onto a helicopter, or even launch an inflatable lifeboat to battle blazes, mount rescue missions, or provide medical attention to those in need.

videos.title: Saves The Day
videos.overview:
1. Beast Of Pontypandy

2. Fit For Nothing

3. Neighbourhood Watch Out

4. The Case Of The Liquorice Shoelaces

5. Firefighter Of Tomorrow

videos.title: Fire Of Pontypandy
videos.overview: When Fireman Sam performs a super-heroic rescue, he is awarded a special bravery medal and offered a new job in Newtown by visiting Chief Fire Officer Boyce. Meanwhile, a Pontypandy Pioneer Scouts camping trip, results in a forest fire that threatens to engulf Pontypandy, forcing everyone to prepare to evacuate ! Will Fireman Sam leave his beloved town, and will this be the end of Pontypandy ?

videos.title: Brave New Rescues
videos.overview: Fireman Sam is back for more heroic adventures in fire safety! Fireman Sam and his friends in Pontypandy work together to save the day when Mike’s kitchen catches fire, Dilys gets stuck out at sea and Norman cries wolf! Come along with the hero next door and his brave brigade for some courageous adventures and daring new rescues the whole family will enjoy!

videos.title: Helicopter Heroes
videos.overview: 1. Stuck in the Muck 2. Sausages versus Shrimps 3. Twiching the Night Away 4. Model Plane 5. Open Day

videos.title: Fireman Sam: The Great Fire of Pontypandy
videos.overview: Fireman Sam: The Great Fire of Pontypandy, known in Scotland as Fireman Sam: The Great Fire of London, is a 2010 animated film, based on the Welsh stop-motion television series, Fireman Sam. Norman, Derek, Sarah & James and Dilys go pioneering with Trevor Evans in the forest. Norman Price and his cousin Derek want a campfire to cook sausages and try to light a fire by rubbing sticks together. The trouble is, Dilys calls them away and the fire gets going without them realising it and the great fire of Pontypandy starts!

videos.title: Heroes of the Storm
videos.overview: Fireman Sam and the team are on a mission to save Pontypandy! Just as the brand new fire station opens and two new recruits arrive, an approaching hurricane threatens Pontypandy! The crew jump into action to prepare the town.

videos.title: Alien Alert
videos.overview: Pontypandy is hit by a raft of UFO sightings and Fireman Sam is determined to get to the bottom of this mystery.

videos.title: Set for Action!
videos.overview: The alarm has sounded and the Pontypandy crew is off to rescue their friends and others in need. From engine sparks and wild fireworks to water rescue and more, you won't want to miss these adventures with your favorite hero, Fireman Sam!

videos.title: Norman Price and the Mystery in the Sky
videos.overview: A series of emergencies have Fireman Sam and PC Malcolm raising their eyebrows, as a mysterious "Flying Man" keeps saving the day just in time.

videos.title: The Kite
videos.overview: Strong winds bring telegraph poles down and take Sarah and James' kite high up, but a little higher than they intended.

videos.title: Barn Fire
videos.overview: On a very hot day, Sarah and James are picking potatoes for Bella. Sam wonders if he can help, but first he has to deal with a barn fire at Pandy Lane Farm.

videos.title: Trevor's Training
videos.overview: It's routine drill for Trevor on his first day in the fire service, until a message comes over the radio.

videos.title: Flat Tyre
videos.overview: After going to a boot-sale, Trevor's  tyre goes flat and invades Pontypandy and loads of delays, luckilly Fireman Sam goes to the rescue.

videos.title: Camping
videos.overview: What have a frog and an oily rag got to do with camping? Sam, Sarah and James soon find out.

videos.title: Norman's Tricky Day
videos.overview: Norman is up to his old tricks as usual, but this time he plays one too many!

videos.title: Lost Cat
videos.overview: Saturdays are busy enough for Bella, without having to deal with chip pan fires and lost cats.

videos.title: Telly Trouble
videos.overview: TV stardom comes to Station Officer Steele and everyone in Pontypandy is tuning in.

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Sam introduces Sarah and James to his new metal detector, and they get hooked on looking for treasure. Unfortunately, they manage to burst a water pipe in the park while searching for Bella's keys! Meanwhile, Norman's game of 'Knights Of The Round Table' backfires when his saucepan helmet gets stuck on his head. Overall, it's a busy day for Sam and the crew...

videos.title: Sam's Day Off
videos.overview: Sam's popcorn machine is just the ticket for the cinemas, until it suffers from a touch of flumbustication!

videos.title: Thief in Pontypandy
videos.overview: Sam's mislaid his watch, Bella's necklace has disappeared and Dilys' earrings have gone missing! Can Sam solve the mystery?

videos.title: Chemistry Set
videos.overview: Norman's dream of making the pongiest stink bomb in the world backfires when Dilys walks into the laboratory.

videos.title: The Wishing Well
videos.overview: Trevor organises a search party when Norman doesn't come back from picking strawberries.

videos.title: The Great Inventor
videos.overview: Sam is all set to win the Best Inventor in Wales competition, until ...

videos.title: Safe With Sam
videos.overview: There is a fireworks display being held to celebrate the anniverary of Pontypandy fire station opening. But there are many valuable lessons to be learned about safety.

videos.title: Snow Business
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve, and Pontypandy's got four inches of festive snow to keep the kids entertained. They're playing snowballs, and everyone around  town is enjoying the cold snap, except for Dylis Price. She's not happy shovelling snow from her shop front and ducking the great hanging icicles above her head. She wonders why the Christmas tree isn't up in the park yet. Why, the Council have been a bit late this year. She suspects they couldn't afford one. Her comments give Fireman Sam a jolly idea...

videos.title: Dilys' Forgetful Day
videos.overview: When Dilys falls off the ladder, Norman's got a lot of explaining to do!

videos.title: Spot of Bother
videos.overview: Norman's double bluff backfires when chicken pox hits Pontypandy.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: It's Halloween in Pontypamdy and Penny is in for a surprise.

videos.title: Norman's Pitfall
videos.overview: Not far from an old disused mineshaft, Norman is fishing for chocolate cream eclairs.

videos.title: Lost Ring
videos.overview: Bella is very happy about the diamond ring she inherited, until it goes missing ...

videos.title: All in a Good Cause
videos.overview: Sam is dumbstruck when all the charity money they've raised for a good cause goes missing ...

videos.title: Brass Band
videos.overview: Only practice makes perfect, but the fire station band needs something quicker than that.

videos.title: Lost in the Fog
videos.overview: Penny becomes anxious when Sarah and James don't arrive for tea.

videos.title: Bentley the Robot
videos.overview: Sam's latest invention is almost superhuman, until it meets Norman Price ...

videos.title: Home from Rome
videos.overview: Rosa stows away in Bella's shopping trolley, when she goes to Bingle's department store. But disaster strikes when a lift gets stuck, and it's up to the Pontypandy fire service to rescue Bella and her cat...

videos.title: Rich and Famous
videos.overview: Dilys wishes she were rich and famous, so goes off to do some treasure hunting in the attic. But she gets more than she bargained for when she knocks over a candle, setting the roof on fire...

videos.title: Quarry Rescue
videos.overview: While Bella is making pizza's for Trevor to deliver James falls into an old quarry. Then Trevor gets his finger stuck in the brake fluid chamber.

videos.title: Deep Trouble
videos.overview: Sam has been sent to weed Penny's cottage garden. Why has Penny been called out to help?

videos.title: Trevor's Bus Boot Sale
videos.overview: Trevor is holding a 'Bus Boot Sale', but then gets trapped at the old dump while suffering from some fumes. After Norman rescues him Norman then gets a surprise from Trevor.

videos.title: What Goes Up
videos.overview: Trevor gets stuck in a balloon and soon its the fire service to the rescue

videos.title: Steele Under Par
videos.overview: When Steele is given a letter of retirement he decides to go golfing. But then his present gets in trouble in Trevor's shed which catches fire.

videos.title: Disaster for Dinner
videos.overview: A fire drill practice is being held at Bella's Cafe, but first there's trouble at 3 Vale Road when Sam's robot catches fire.

videos.title: Danger Falling Sheep
videos.overview: When naughty Norman tries to conquer Pontypandy Mountain he finds himself stranded on a ledge with a fallen lamb.

videos.title: Twist of Fate
videos.overview: Station Officer Steele takes Norman and Mandy Flood pot-holing, but he soon ends up in a tight spot.

videos.title: A Real Livewire
videos.overview: Mandy thinks a squirrel will be a good pet, but its taste for electrical cables causes a fire.

videos.title: Bug Eyed Boy From Venus
videos.overview: When Trevor Evans tells the children that there's no such thing as little green men from outer space, Norman is determined to prove him wrong.

videos.title: Bathtime for Dusty
videos.overview: Scruffy dog Dusty is chosen to be the fire station mascot, but first he must have a bath. Dusty is not keen on the idea, though.

videos.title: Neighbourhood Watchout
videos.overview: Mandy, Sarah and James decide to start a junior neighbourhood watch scheme, but get rather carried away.

videos.title: Twitchers in Trouble
videos.overview: Trevor is looking forward to his date with Dilys and decides to take her birdwatching. However, a fire at Trevor's birdwatching hide ensures that the date is hotter than planned.

videos.title: Carnival of Junk
videos.overview: A rubbish tip proves to be a trap for the unwary James, but then the recycled rubbish becomes the centrepiece in a Caribbean-style carnival.

videos.title: Mummy's Little Pumpkin
videos.overview: Halloween is scarier than normal after Norman leaves his pumpkin lantern unattended.

videos.title: Joker Soaker
videos.overview: To everyone's horror, Norman has a new toy - a ""Joker Soaker"" water pistol!

videos.title: Fit For Nothing
videos.overview: The Fire-fighters are training hard to appear in the Wales Fittest Fire-fighters calendar. It's a competition to see who is the fittest.

videos.title: Deep Water
videos.overview: Mandy and Norman get into deep water when they go hunting for treasure.

videos.title: Beast of Pontypandy
videos.overview: A black beast has appeared in Pontypandy and Woolly has disappeared...

videos.title: Pizza Palaver
videos.overview: Bella is as sick as a parrot when a bird's nest falls down the chimney and into her new oven.

videos.title: Fun Run
videos.overview: Today in Pontypandy, a fun run has been organised for charity. Unfortunately Norman's cheating ways put James and the other competitors in danger.

videos.title: Trouble and Squeak
videos.overview: Norman has taken the school mouse home to look after. Unsurprisingly, it escapes and causes havock when both Rosa and the mouse end up stuck in Bella's chimney.

videos.title: King of the Jungle
videos.overview: The Tarzanesque jungle cry of naughty Norman Price raises the alarm when the twins get caught in a blazing haystack.

videos.title: Norman's Invisible Friend
videos.overview: Norman invents a fictitious friend to get double helpings of everything.

videos.title: High Jinx
videos.overview: Norman uses a power kite to help his with his deliveries.

videos.title: The Case of the Liquorice Shoelaces
videos.overview: Someone has been stealing shoelaces from Dilys's shop and the prime suspect is Naughty Norman. Surprisingly he isn't to blame and he sets out to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Fiery Finale
videos.overview: There's a talent show in Pontypandy, and Norman Price is searching for an act.

videos.title: Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: It is Sam's birthday and everyone is keen to surprise him. Norman is tasked with keeping Sam out of the gym, but a fire at Bella's café distracts Sam.

videos.title: Firefighter of Tomorrow
videos.overview: Norman wants to be a fireman when he grows up, but decides he can't wait that long.

videos.title: Fields of Fire
videos.overview: Sam receives new equipment for fighting fires. It proves to be useful when careless campers fail to put out their fires in the fields.

videos.title: Let it Snow
videos.overview: Naughty Norman has his heart set on a Christmas tree.

videos.title: The Big Freeze
videos.overview: Norman raises everyone's temperature with the bed he builds for his pet lamb Woolly.

videos.title: Blow Me Down
videos.overview: Station Officer Steele gets out his kite and pretends it's his nephew's. When he tries to fly it at the Flood's house, it gets stuck on the roof. Meanwhile Norman Price, Charlie Jones and Dilys Price are in need of help in the sea. Fireman Sam is in charge at the Fire Station, so he goes to the rescue.

videos.title: Pontypandy Extreme
videos.overview: Norman is upset when Trevor accidentally runs over his skateboard. Not prepared to wait until his birthday for a new board, Norman decides to retrieve coins from the bottom of a wishing well and buy one himself. When Norman becomes trapped, Sam must use the abseiling skills he has just learned from Tom to rescue him.

videos.title: Elvis Sings The Blues
videos.overview: Elvis Cridlington breaks his leg dancing around the Fire Station and begins to wonder if he is really cut out to be a firefighter. But when Mike Flood ends up dangling precariously from his roof and Norman gets his head stuck in railings, it is up to Elvis to save the day.

videos.title: Fireworks For Mandy
videos.overview: While playing hide-and-seek in the mountains with Norman, Mandy finds a distress flare. Norman wants to let it off but Mandy resists, fearing that it could be dangerous. When they discover Penny stranded on a cliff, they use the flare to raise the alarm. It is up to Sam, Elvis and Tom to rescue Penny.

videos.title: Heap Of Trouble
videos.overview: For the Pontypandy Flower and Vegetable show, Mike is entering a marrow that he has been growing on his compost heap. But he did not heed Sam's advice about turning over his compost regularly, so when he removes his marrow, the air gets into the heap and starts a fire!

videos.title: Twitching The Night Away
videos.overview: Norman and Trevor go bird watching. Elvis is preparing to go on a TV show and says he might not be a fireman for much longer. However he decides to help when the forest catches fire.

videos.title: Stuck In The Muck
videos.overview: There's trouble for Trevor Evans as the school bus swerves off the road and breaks down in the Pontypandy hills. Unfortunately, mobile phones have no signal up in the Welsh hills and he is stranded - with a beast about. Fireman Sam comes to the rescue, with the assistance of Tom in the helicopter. Then they search for Trevor, who made an attempt of finding help. In the end everyone is safe and they go home. Norman spots a black animal passing over the road just before the bus rounds a corner, but when he tells everyone else about his sighting, nobody believes him.

videos.title: Sausages Versus Shrimps
videos.overview: Norman Price gets Trevor Evans and Tom Thomas to have a competition to see whose food tastes better. Trevor Evans puts a lot of coal on to his barbecue, soon causing some trees to catch fire.

videos.title: Flood's Flood
videos.overview: As preparations are made for a Pontypandy Karaoke night, Sam and the other firefighters prepare for a drill. Mike Flood works on repairs for Bronwyn but he gets trapped in the Jones' basement, after he accidentally jams the door and causing a small leak to turn into a flood. Fireman Sam comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Off Duty Sam
videos.overview: It is Fireman Sam's day off, but it doesn't last! He saves Mike Flood from the roof, and saves Norman Price from quicksand. He stops Trevor Evans' bus going off the road, and then puts out a fire in Dilys Price's store.

videos.title: Stranded
videos.overview: Mandy Flood and Norman Price head off to the beach with their buckets and nets challenging each other to see who will obtain the best catch of the day where Mandy finds a whale stranded on the beach and the crew have to try to rescue it.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Norman Price sends his cousin Derek on a wild goose chase to get some Pontypandy pansies but starts worrying he has got into some kind of trouble when he doesn't return. Fireman Sam comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Sheepdog Trials
videos.overview: Norman Price practices his new career as a shepherd by rounding up Woolly with Radar. However, Woolly and her lamb run into the road and make Mike Flood's van tip over. Firefighter Cridlington and Station Officer Steele get the hiccups.

videos.title: Norman's Ghost
videos.overview: It's Halloween and everyone in Pontypandy is looking forward to the big party at the Floods' house. Norman Price gets into the Halloween spirit by pretending Pontypandy is haunted by a ghost, but then manages to set the Floods' house on fire. Firemen Sam, Elvis and Station Officer Steele come to the rescue.

videos.title: Poorly Penny
videos.overview: On Fireman Sam's day off the crew are inundated with the Jones' emergencies. Firefighter Penny Morris has caught a cold, but she still tries to perform her firefighter duties. However, when the Joneses get stuck on Charlie's boat, Penny's illness takes hold while she is out on Neptune alone, and Sam has to come to the rescue.

videos.title: Pirates Of Pontypandy
videos.overview: James and Norman get trapped in a row boat at sea when their pirating adventures get a little out of hand. Lion the cat is not allowed in the Fire Station so Fireman Sam takes him back to Bronwyn.

videos.title: The Pontypandy Pioneers
videos.overview: With Fireman Sam out on an emergency, Trevor Evans leads some young explorers on a nature walk to the Mountain Rescue Centre, but is he up to it? He gets himself stuck and Fireman Sam comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Sailor Steele
videos.overview: Fireman Sam and the rest of the team are training Mike Flood and Charlie Jones to be reserve firemen, and Station Officer Steele is very pleased with their progress. Both Charlie and Mike are itching to fight a fire but the training has prevented Charlie from going out in his fishing boat and there is no fish for the Wholefish Cafe. Charlie and Station Officer Steele they go out in the fishing boat, but are cast adrift after an engine fire leaves their boat stranded.

videos.title: Fireman James
videos.overview: James is keen to be a firefighter and listens to calls to Jupiter on his walkie-talkie. After one call he gets to Norman and Lion first and helps rescue them, but then a later call sees him trapped by fire at the Flood's house.

videos.title: Dilys' Big Surprise
videos.overview: Norman Price tries to make his Mum's birthday special by making a cake with Mike Flood, but they end up causing a fire. Fireman Sam comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Day At The Seaside
videos.overview: It is Station Officer Steele's day off from the Fire Service. Elvis persuades Sam to let him be in charge at the fire station. Station Officer Steele, Trevor Evans, Nurse Flood, Mandy, Norman and Dilys Price go to the seaside together, but will the SatNav get them there?

videos.title: Model Plane
videos.overview: James has a new model airplane which Norman has a go at but flies it into Station Officer Steele who demands that he not fly it in Pontypandy. Norman persuades James to take it to the Mountain Rescue Center and fly it but it lands in a tree and leads to them getting stuck.

videos.title: Three Legged Race
videos.overview: In the annual three-legged race in Pontypandy, Fireman Sam is partnered with a less-than-confident Dilys Price. Norman Price tries to cheat but then hurts his leg. Fireman Sam and Tom Thomas come to the rescue in the helicopter.

videos.title: Norman's Ark
videos.overview: The residents of Pontypandy wake up to find the whole of the town flooded! Fireman Sam and Tom Thomas the helicopter pilot lend a hand where they can and Fireman Elvis Cridlington and Firefighter Penny Morris come to the rescue in the rescue boat. Meanwhile Norman Price goes off to look for Woolly and Lambikins.

videos.title: Open Day
videos.overview: It is open day at Pontypandy Fire Station and everyone is invited to visit and have a look around. Norman and James end up stuck on the roof when they want to see more and have to be rescued by Fireman Sam.

videos.title: Mike's Rocket
videos.overview: Mike has built a rocket and is preparing to launch it. Norman has become fascinated by Mike's project and wants to build and launch one of his own.

videos.title: Paper Plane Down
videos.overview: Norman's paper aeroplanes really heat things up at the fire station kitchen.

videos.title: Hot & Cold Running Sniffer Dog
videos.overview: Mike doesn't believe that Radar is a rescue dog, but he is soon proved wrong after he falls and breaks his arm in the Whole Fish Cafe cellar.

videos.title: Hearts On Fire
videos.overview: Norman, Trevor, and Dilys go camping and see the sunset from the woods. Dilys panics thinking it is a forest fire, and she unwittingly knocks a log from the camp fire causing a real fire to start.

videos.title: Perilous Path
videos.overview: Norman, Mandy, and Radar go out to find a golden eagle, but Norman ignores the danger signs and gets trapped on a crumbling cliff.

videos.title: The New Hero Next Door
videos.overview: Mandy wants to film a rescue but the Fire Brigade don't have anyone to rescue so along with Sarah, James and Norman, they fake an emergency but Charlie wanting to be a hero thinks Sarah's cries for help are real, and ends up needing rescuing himself.

videos.title: Santa Overboard
videos.overview: It is nearly Christmas in Pontypandy and Norman is keen to have the best Christmas decorations, which leads to Dilys putting too many into one plug socket, leading to a fire.

videos.title: Best Foot Forward
videos.overview: Norman Price goes mussel collecting with Charlie, Sarah and James. He attempts to get the most mussels, but ends up getting his foot wedged between two rocks.

videos.title: Baa Baa Baby
videos.overview: After being fooled into thinking Woolly's lamb is a baby crying, Sarah decides to push the lamb around in her old pram to see if she can trick the townsfolk. When it rains, Sarah leaves her coat over a heater in the cafe, leading to a fire and Sam needing to rescue the "baby".

videos.title: Mother's Helper
videos.overview: Helen goes away on a course, leaving Mike to do all of the housework. When he leaves the iron on whilst he goes out to fix Dilys' washing machine, a fire starts.

videos.title: Cat Magic
videos.overview: Bronwyn takes Sarah and James to the wishing well to make wishes, but nobody notices Lion the cat get stuck in the well and soon he needs to be rescued.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Bronwyn takes Sarah and Nipper the dog out on a walk along the cliffs to tire out Nipper, but trouble strikes when Sarah trips on a rock and hurts her leg. However, thanks to Fireman Cridlington's new song they remember that red is a sign for danger.

videos.title: Going Out With A Bang
videos.overview: While looking for Lion the cat, Mandy Flood knocks over a firework and starts a fire in Mike's workshop.

videos.title: The Wrong Smell
videos.overview: Helen Flood and Firefighter Penny Morris go on a mountain hike while Firefighter Cridlington tries to teach Radar the Rescue Dog how to roll over. When the fog rolls in and Firefighter Penny Morris hurts her ankle, she and Helen Flood become lost. Fireman Sam, Radar the Rescue Dog and Tom Thomas come to the rescue.

videos.title: No Nurse Like You
videos.overview: Mike Flood and Helen Flood are having their anniversary party, but a storm and a power cut end up causing a fire and Station Officer Steele to bump and hurt his nose.

videos.title: The One That Got Away
videos.overview: Norman Price goes fishing with Charlie, Sarah and James. They discover a baby whale heading for the beach and try to stop it, but land themselves into trouble when Norman makes the boat crash into the whale.

videos.title: Dinosaur Hunt
videos.overview: Norman Price and Trevor Evans discover an ammonite on the beach which inspires Norman to create the illusion of real dinosaurs for James and Sarah. James chases the sound of Norman's "dinosaur growls" into a beach cave where both boys become stranded by the rising tide. Meanwhile, Sarah is stranded on a rock. Sam and Penny come to their rescue.

videos.title: Floating Cart
videos.overview: Norman Price builds a go-cart with items he has collected from around Pontypandy, but of these items are collected without permission, causing problems for others. He loses control of the cart on its maiden voyage and falls off the quay. Fireman Sam comes to his rescue.

videos.title: Sticky Situation
videos.overview: Norman Price doesn't follow the directions on his model airplane kit and ends up stuck to his bedroom door during a fire. Fireman Sam comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Cry Wolf
videos.overview: Norman accidentally sets off Dilys' new fire alarm, so she confiscates his football. To get it back, he sets the alarm off again, and again when a fox enters the shop.

videos.title: Sheep On The Road
videos.overview: Woolly is sent to stay with Norman, who is ill, whilst Mike mends her field's gate. Unfortunately, Norman and Woolly go out, resulting in Trevor's bus swerving off the road and dangling over the edge of the cliff.

videos.title: Mam's Day
videos.overview: It's Mother's Day, but Norman only wants to go skateboarding. He makes Dilys a very unsafe candle holder and when she takes it to the Whole Fish Cafe, a fire starts.

videos.title: Alarm On The Beach
videos.overview: When James and Mandy find a crate on the beach, they try to open it, but end up trapping James' legs under the crate.

videos.title: Hot Air
videos.overview: It's a very hot day in Pontypandy and Trevor Evans refuses to accept that his old bus may not make it up the mountain. When the engine overheats, Trevor ignores Norman's advice, opens the bonnet, and starts a fire.

videos.title: Towering Inferno
videos.overview: Norman Price, Mandy Flood and the twins play hide and seek, but Norman tries to hide in the fire station training tower while the firefighters are running a drill. Fireman Sam comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Danger By The Double
videos.overview: James and Sarah will not stop competing. When a fire starts in the forest they are too busy trying to outdo each other to realize they are in danger.

videos.title: When Fools Rush In
videos.overview: James wants to get Bronwyn something special for her birthday, so he borrows Station Officer Steele's metal detector to find ancient coins, but he ignores Steele's advice and gets trapped by rocks near the cliffs.

videos.title: Elvis Sings the Blues
videos.overview: Elvis breaks his leg and wonders if he is cut out to be a fireman. Station Officer Steele is back on the job and leads the team to rescue Mike Flood who has slipped and is dangling from the roof. Unfortunately, Steele gets into trouble himself when Norman gets his head stuck in the railings and only Elvis is available to help.

videos.title: Off Duty Sam
videos.overview: Once his shift is over, Sam can't wait to get home and do his chores. But that'll have to wait when one thing leads to another at Dilys' shop.

videos.title: Poorly Penny
videos.overview: While Sam is enjoying his day off, Penny comes down with a cold, yet still tries to do her duty when the Jones family land themselves in trouble.

videos.title: Stranded
videos.overview: Norman and Mandy discover a baby whale stranded on the beach. Sam, Penny, and Tom Thomas save the day!

videos.title: When Fools Rush In
videos.overview: James wants to get Bronwyn something special for her birthday, so he borrows Station Officer Steele's metal detector to find ancient coins, but he ignores Steele's advice and gets trapped by rocks near the cliffs.

videos.title: Blow Me Down
videos.overview: Norman thinks he is a great sailor and takes Dilys out for a sail. Mandy, James, and Sarah are flying Station Officer Steele's new kite and when it's Steele's turn, the kite ends up on the roof of the Floods' house.

videos.title: Sausages vs Shrimps
videos.overview: Pontypandy turns up the heat with a barbeque cook-off between Trevor with his famous sausages and Tom with his special king prawns.

videos.title: Bronwyn's Millionth Customer
videos.overview: When Sarah and James discover that the Wholefish Café is about to have its one millionth customer, they convince Bronwyn that there should be a big celebration to mark the event.

videos.title: Jupiter On The Loose
videos.overview: When the Pontypandy Pioneers go to the fire station to complete their fire safety badge, Norman wants to prove to his cousin Derek that he can drive a fire engine.

videos.title: The Big Chill
videos.overview: When the power goes out at the fire station, Sam has trouble lighting a fire.

videos.title: Boyce Will Be Boyce
videos.overview: Station Officer Steele hurts his back and Chief Fire Officer Boyce fills in his role for the day.

videos.title: Elvis In Concert
videos.overview: Pontypandy is holding a Charity Concert and Elvis is to be the star act. Mike and Elvis have got a giant wooden guitar, but they fail to see a cliff and Mike ends up falling down, clinging onto it.

videos.title: Mandy At Sea
videos.overview: Mandy wants to be a round-the-world yachtswoman, but when her mast breaks she finds herself stranded at sea.

videos.title: The Great Guinea Pig Rescue
videos.overview: Sarah and James have got a pet guinea pig and name him Norris, Station Officer Steele's real name, but then the guinea pig's taste for cables soon leads to a fire.

videos.title: The Pontypandy Polar Bear
videos.overview: Huge footprints in the snow convince Sarah that there's a polar bear in the area. But she and James get into difficulties when they try to photograph it for a local newspaper competition.

videos.title: Water Tower Inferno
videos.overview: It's a big day in Pontypandy, Gareth is opening the Pontypandy mountain railway line and station; he has refurbished the old engine, The Pontypandy Flyer, to take people up and down the mountain. But the water tower threatens to fall and put the train in danger.

videos.title: Mandy's Mountain
videos.overview: When Mandy reads Moose Roberts’ book about his mountain climbing adventures, she decides that she wants to be a mountain climber when she grows up – and climb the highest mountain in the world!

videos.title: Runaway Train
videos.overview: When Bronwyn gives her father Gareth Griffiths a sausage sandwich for his lunch, she has no idea the lengths Nipper the dog will go to for a bite!

videos.title: The Pontypandyness Monster
videos.overview: Sarah makes up a story about a monster to get more customers on her Grandad's railway.

videos.title: Disastrous Dilys
